# The official-news feed

Official press releases (central banks, regulators, governments).

The public-sector module's official-news pack (docs/guides/PUBLIC_SECTOR_GUIDE.md): Press releases and notices from the publishers' own feeds: the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank, the Bank of Canada, the Bank of England, the SEC, OSFI, the US Federal Register and the Canada Gazette. A publisher's page lists its latest releases newest first, each a link to the original, with its terms; a release's page gives its title, date, summary and link. Each publisher's terms are recorded: the Bank of England, OSFI and the Canada Gazette allow no commercial reuse, so their releases are internal only. Filled daily by the official-news feed into the newslake lake.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | Federal Reserve Board, European Central Bank, Bank of Canada, Bank of England, US Securities and Exchange Commission, OSFI, US Federal Register, Canada Gazette, Part II, Canada Gazette, Part I (https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases.htm) |
| Licence | [per publisher (options.sources): public domain, reuse with attribution, or internal only (Bank of England, OSFI, Canada Gazette)](https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | Each release names its publisher (PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION). |
| Notes | the releases of a publisher whose terms allow no commercial reuse carry INTERNAL_ONLY true; Export data refuses them |
| Lake | `newslake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 19:00 (local time) |
| Pull | `official_news.OfficialNewsFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/official_news.py); 1 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run official-news --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run official-news                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/official-news/<date>/, load into newslake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status official-news             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [FEEDS_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/FEEDS_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### release-source

Pack `official-news`, kind `release-source` (Official press releases), table `release-source`, key `SOURCE_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/official-news/<date>/release-source.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_ID` | id | required | PRESS- and the publisher's id in the feed's YAML (FED, ECB, BOC, BOE, SEC, OSFI, FEDREG, GAZETTE1, GAZETTE2). |
| `NAME` | text | required | The publisher's name. |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | text | required | What the publisher is. |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). |
| `WEBSITE` | text | optional | The publisher's page of releases. |
| `FEED_URL` | text | required | The address the feed reads (RSS, Atom, or the Federal Register's API). |
| `LICENCE` | text | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. |
| `TERMS_URL` | text | optional | The publisher's terms page. |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). |
| `WHY_INTERNAL` | text | optional | Why the publisher's releases are internal only, in words; empty when they are not. |
| `RELEASES` | integer | required | How many releases are kept (the last keep-days, at most keep-per-source). |
| `LAST_PUBLISHED` | timestamp | optional | When the newest kept release was published (UTC). |
| `LAST_PULL` | text | required | ok, or failed (the kept releases are shown) when the publisher's feed could not be read. |
| `LATEST` | record list | required | The newest 25 releases, newest first: PUBLISHED, TITLE, URL, CATEGORY and PRESS_RELEASE. |
| `BY_CATEGORY` | record list | required | The kept releases counted by category (CATEGORY, COUNT), the largest first. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"SOURCE_ID": "PRESS-BOC", "NAME": "Bank of Canada", "PUBLISHER_TYPE": "central bank", "COUNTRY": "CAN", "WEBSITE": "https://www.bankofcanada.ca/press/press-releases/", "FEED_URL": "https://www.bankofcanada.ca/content_type/press-releases/fee…", "LICENCE": "Bank of Canada terms of use: free to use, copy, distribute …", "TERMS_URL": "https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/", "INTERNAL_ONLY": false, "WHY_INTERNAL": "The Bank of England allows personal and internal non-commer…", "RELEASES": 5, "LAST_PUBLISHED": "2026-11-05T16:00:19Z", "LAST_PULL": "ok"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/official-news/contracts/release-source.contract.yaml` ([official-news](../../docs/contracts/packs/official-news.md)).

### press-release

Pack `official-news`, kind `press-release` (Press release), table `press-release`, key `RELEASE_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/official-news/<date>/press-release.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RELEASE_ID` | id | required | PREL-, the publisher's id and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-1 of the release's address. |
| `TITLE` | text | required | The release's title as the publisher's feed gives it. |
| `PUBLISHED` | timestamp | optional | When the release was published, in UTC. |
| `DATE` | date | optional | The day it was published (UTC). |
| `URL` | text | required | The release on the publisher's site: open it for the full text. |
| `SUMMARY` | text | optional | The summary the publisher's feed gives, as plain text cut at 400 characters; empty when the feed gives none. |
| `CATEGORY` | text | optional | The publisher's category (the Federal Register: the document type and agencies). |
| `RELEASE_SOURCE` | id | required | The publisher's page (PRESS-<id>). |
| `PUBLISHER_NAME` | text | required | The publisher's name. |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | text | required | What the publisher is. |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"RELEASE_ID": "PREL-FED-0224349908", "TITLE": "Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement …", "PUBLISHED": "2026-11-05T16:00:00Z", "DATE": "2026-11-05", "URL": "https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enf…", "SUMMARY": "Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement …", "CATEGORY": "Enforcement Actions", "RELEASE_SOURCE": "PRESS-FED", "PUBLISHER_NAME": "Federal Reserve Board", "PUBLISHER_TYPE": "central bank", "COUNTRY": "USA", "INTERNAL_ONLY": false}
```

The contract: `config/packs/official-news/contracts/press-release.contract.yaml` ([official-news](../../docs/contracts/packs/official-news.md)).
